no_guide.experimental_board: No switch on any screen: the task board is turned on in config.json only, for testing.

body.en: Start Claude Code, Codex or another AI CLI, or a plain terminal. On macOS and Linux a tab keeps running when ShellBot restarts.
body.zh: 開 Claude Code、Codex 或其他 AI CLI，也可以開一般終端機。在 macOS 和 Linux 上，ShellBot 重啟時分頁會繼續跑。

body.en: Every tab is listed here. Click one to switch to it, double-click to rename it. ↻ checks every tab's state again.
body.zh: 所有分頁都列在這裡。點一下切換，點兩下改名。↻ 會重新判斷每個分頁的狀態。

body.en: A tab's light becomes a face: idle, working, a question for you, stuck, done. A tab can become a bot that wakes with its job, skills and memory, and writes its memory before it closes.
body.zh: 分頁的燈號變成 bot 的臉：發呆、運作中、有問題要問你、卡住、完成。分頁可以開成 bot，叫醒時帶著執掌、skill 和記憶，關閉前先把記憶寫好。

body.en: Read a tab as a conversation, or switch to its live terminal.
body.zh: 分頁可以用對話的樣子看，也可以切回即時的終端機。

body.en: ⟳ on an AI tab restarts its CLI to pick up an update. Claude Code and Codex come back to the same conversation.
body.zh: AI 分頁上的 ⟳ 會重啟它的 CLI、套用更新。Claude Code 和 Codex 會接回同一段對話。

body.en: How much of each AI account's 5-hour and weekly allowance is used. Click for the details and the pace.
body.zh: 每個 AI 帳號的 5 小時和每週額度用了多少。點開看細節和用量速度。

body.en: Shows a pairing code and a QR code. Scan it with the ShellBot app on an iPhone or iPad, or enter the code on another computer, to see and drive these tabs from there.
body.zh: 顯示配對碼和 QR code。用 iPhone、iPad 上的 ShellBot App 掃，或在另一台電腦輸入配對碼，就能從那邊看、操作這裡的分頁。

body.en: Talk to your tabs from Telegram: paste a bot token here and connect. Messages go to the primary bot, which can pass work to the others.
body.zh: 從 Telegram 跟分頁對話：在這裡貼上 bot token 再連線。訊息會送給主要 bot，它可以再把工作交給其他 bot。

body.en: The same for a LINE Official Account: its channel token and secret here, then connect.
body.zh: LINE 官方帳號也可以：在這裡填 channel token 和 secret，再連線。

body.en: Browse and install plugins that add features to ShellBot.
body.zh: 瀏覽和安裝替 ShellBot 加功能的外掛。

body.en: The AI in a tab can send work or a note to another bot by its name, here or on a paired computer, and hand off a task that reports back. Off by default.
body.zh: 分頁裡的 AI 可以用名字把工作或訊息交給另一個 bot，這台或配對的電腦都可以，也能交辦一件事、做完回報。預設關閉。

body.en: Put roles in a group and send one message to all of them; the replies come back as one conversation. Off by default.
body.zh: 把角色組成群組，一則訊息送給全部成員，回覆合成一段對話。預設關閉。

body.en: A side panel with the conversations that run on a schedule (/loop, cron routines, scheduled tabs): when each wakes next and what it waits on. Off by default.
body.zh: 側邊面板列出按排程跑的對話（/loop、cron routine、排程開的分頁）：下次什麼時候醒、在等什麼。預設關閉。

body.en: Language, font size, what the + menu offers, Telegram and LINE, plugins, and the experimental features.
body.zh: 語言、字級、＋ 選單裡有哪些、Telegram 和 LINE、外掛，還有實驗性功能。

body.en: The AI in your tabs learns how to use ShellBot (open tabs, read other tabs, message them) from `sfctl skill`. This shows what it reads.
body.zh: 分頁裡的 AI 從 `sfctl skill` 學會怎麼用 ShellBot（開分頁、看別的分頁、傳訊息）。這裡看得到它讀的內容。

body.en: Open it again any time: every feature with where to find it, and what is new since you last looked.
body.zh: 隨時可以再打開：每個功能在哪裡、怎麼用，還有上次看過之後的新功能。
